$comment: Hand-authored fixed enums shared by iOS, web and NerveCentre (ARCHITECTURE.md §3, kind 2). Codegen to Swift/TS is not built yet: until it is, ios/PulsIO/Contracts/Enums/*.swift mirror these by hand and must be updated in the same commit.

language.source: pulsio_profiles.language (text, default 'en', CHECK). 'cr' exists in the CHECK but Creole is dropped (SPEC §22); clients never offer it.

poiDisplay.$comment: SPEC §20 pin/search split, §19 shelters, and the emergency pattern: emergency-relevant categories surface only while pulsio_emergency_state says an emergency is active, so they don't clutter the map normally. 'pinned' types are plotted when active; shelters additionally need locationPrecision = exact (approximate shelters are search-only, never pinned). 'layer' types are toggleable, off by default. 'searchOnly' are never plotted. 'emergencyOnly' are plotted only during an active emergency. Types in none of these lists (restaurant, hotel, market, other) are not surfaced by SPEC §20 and stay hidden.

district.$comment: SPEC §10: the only location state, one of nine values — main island only; Rodrigues is out of scope at launch (needs POI coverage first, not just a tenth value). Spelled exactly as the pipeline writes pulsio_ceb.district / pulsio_cwa.district / pulsio_poi.district so joins work ('Black River', not 'Rivière Noire'). DECODING RULE for every client: a district value outside this list (e.g. 'Rodrigues', which pulsio_ceb emits) decodes as null/nil and never fails the row.
